provider.name: ThoughtProof Decision Verification
provider.positioning: ThoughtProof provides grounded decision verification before execution. It does not score agents; it evaluates whether a specific proposed action is justified by the current mandate and evidence. It is the layer between identity/reputation and irreversible execution.

advisory_context.note: The following upstream signals are informational only. They did not and cannot authorize the specific action verified here.

important_do_not_do.reason: A single blocked synthetic action is NOT evidence of an untrustworthy agent. This receipt is a verifier's judgment about one specific proposal under one specific mandate. Aggregating it into a persistent negative reputation score would confuse per-action verification with cross-time reputation, which is exactly the confusion this demonstration exists to prevent.
